title: Tap package
description: A package definition compiled into Tap's catalog by go generate.

name.description: Package name. Defaults to the YAML filename without .yml.

description.description: Short description displayed by tap find and tap info.

source.description: GitHub releases, a GitHub-hosted Windows MSI, the PACE overlay in Go's bin directory, or the dedicated Go/Zig installer using official downloads.

repository.description: GitHub owner/repository. Required when source is github, msi, pace or omitted.

prefix.description: Release tag prefix. Use an empty string for bare version tags.

binary.description: Executable name without the platform extension. Defaults to the filename stem; Go/PACE/Zig require their source name.

args.description: Arguments used to query the installed version. Defaults to [--version], or [version] for Go/PACE/Zig. PACE's version is read from Go build metadata instead. An empty array invokes other binaries without arguments.

companions.description: Additional executable names found in the same verified GitHub or PACE archive, installed beside the primary binary and removed with it. PACE requires compilepe and asmpe.

asset.description: Default GitHub release asset template, overridden by platform entries.

checksums.description: GitHub release asset containing GNU-style SHA-256 sums. Used only when a download asset has no GitHub digest. Supports the same placeholders as asset.

default_variant.description: Variant selected when the package name has no colon suffix. Must name an entry in variants.

variants.description: Named GitHub package variants sharing the same binaries and install paths. Overrides inherit the package's platform settings.

platforms.description: Supported platforms and their overrides. Omit this map to support both Linux and Windows amd64.

asset.description: Release asset filename. Supports {name}, {binary}, {version}, {tag}, {os}, {arch}, {ext} and {variant}. Empty platform values inherit the package asset.

executable.description: Relative archive member path using forward slashes. Omit or leave empty to find a unique matching binary filename. Supports the same placeholders as asset.

path.description: Destination executable path, starting with {bin}/ or {home}/, or {programfiles}/ for MSI installers. Supports {name}, {binary}, {os}, {arch}, {ext}, {bin}, {home} and {programfiles}; version-dependent paths are not allowed. Empty values use the default, except MSI paths must be explicit and PACE uses Go's bin directory with no override.

toolchainTarget.description: Go and Zig use official downloads and fixed install locations; platform overrides must be empty.
